TANGER - TÉTOUAN - AL HOCEIMA
INVESTANGIER

[...] S'il est des régions qui focalisent Notre attention, et qui incarnent Notre choix stratégique de faire de la Région un espace propice pour l'investissement, ce sont bien nos provinces du Nord et du Sud, dont Nous entendons faire un modèle de développement régional intégré.

Dans ce cadre, et parallèlement à la volonté de faire de Tanger et de son port actuel, l'un des plus grands ports et l'une des stations balnéaires majeures de la Méditerranée, Nous avons donné Nos instructions pour l'étude et la réalisation d'un grand ensemble structurant, portuaire, commercial et industriel, sur les rives du Détroit, à l'Est de Tanger.

Le niveau international de cet ouvrage et sa connexion avec des zones franches, sont de nature à concrétiser Notre volonté de permettre à nos provinces du Nord de se désenclaver, de réaliser leur développement intégré et de s'inscrire comme acteur et partenaire dans les échanges économiques mondiaux.

Compte tenu de l'ampleur des investissements et des enjeux stratégiques, et eu égard à la nécessité d'assurer une coordination rigoureuse entre toutes les composantes du projet et les organismes publics, y compris l'Agence de développement des provinces du Nord, et les opérateurs économiques privés, et en provenance de pays frères et amis, Nous avons décidé de créer un organisme de droit privé, doté de prérogatives de puissance publique, et bénéficiant de tous les avantages de nature à lui permettre de mener dans les meilleures conditions, toutes les opérations liées à la réalisation de ce grand projet. [...]

EXTRAIT DU DISCOURS DU ROI MOHAMMED VI
À L'OCCASION DU TROISIÈME ANNIVERSAIRE DE SON ACCESSION AU TRÔNE,
30 juillet 2002.

Editorial
PC

Esteemed readers,

It is with great pride that we share with you some figures regarding the
remarkable achievements of the Tangier-Tetouan-Al Hoceima region in
terms of productive investment. These achievements are the outcome
of collective intelligence within the entire investment community of a
region that has quickly become a driving force for development on a
national scale. Indeed, thanks to its numerous natural and economic
assets, as well as its superb infrastructure, such as the Tangier Med port
complex and high-speed rail, the region has positioned itself as a
natural gateway at the crossroads of Europe, Africa, the Americas, and
Asia.

This phenomenal transformation is the direct consequence of an
enlightened vision promulgated by His Majesty King Mohammed VI,
May God Assist Him. Besides, a comprehensive strategic paradigm,

centered on fostering the allure of productive investments, has
fostered the patronage of a host of esteemed international

corporations.

The impact of this strategy translates through a
significant number of large-scale investment projects
submitted to the Regional Investment Center of the
region. In 2023, the Unified Regional Investment
Commission (CRUI) approved ‘709 investment
projects that total upwards of 73 billion dirhams,
ultimately facilitating as they do the creation of
more than ‘70,000 direct jobs.

Furthermore, since the introduction of the
new investment Charter in 2023, the Unified
Regional Investment Commission has also
played a crucial role by approving 44

www.investangier.com

Ve

investment convention projects worth approximately 18 billion
dirhams, generating thereby 10,200 jobs in the medium and the
long terms.

In terms of entrepreneurship, the region has distinguished itself
by clinching the second position nationally, marked by the
establishment of 12,715 businesses as of November 30, 2023.
These achievements testify to the efficacy of our approach,
underscored as it is by concerted efforts that aim at bolstering the
coordinated facilitation of investors and project stakeholders, and
promoting the intrinsic allure of our fertile and promising
territories, fostering thus a_ diversification of productive
investments, and engendering the sustainable creation of
employment opportunities. We eagerly anticipate the continued
collaboration of all the parties involved towards securing a
prosperous future for our region.

Jalal BENHAYOUN

CEO of the Regional Investment Center,
Tangier-Tetouan-AlHoceima.

The region of Tangier - Tetouan - Al Hoceima has always been
a land of contrasts. It both an authentic and a cosmopolitan
space, yet it possesses a hinterland where rurality, culture,
heritage, and gastronomy are the building blocks of the
identity of a territory oriented towards the sea.
Tourism is a significant pillar of the regional economy,
alongside industry, for it contributes 9.9% []] to the national
GDP. This flagship sector, upon which the region has heavily
banked for its economic takeoff, not only generates wealth but
also serves as a catalyst for economic and social development.

Tangier-Asilah
The Art of MICE

With its millennia-old history, Tangier stands as one of the oldest cities in
the world. At the crossroads of history and universal civilizations, the

Prefecture of Tangier-Asilah embodies both tradition and modernity.

Benefitting as it does from a highly favorable coastal environment for
thermal and nautical activities, as well as a well-developed logistical and
industrial infrastructure, it also harbors significant potential as a
destination for business tourism, particularly following the inauguration
of the Tanger Med port and the high-speed rail line. Moreover, it serves
as a meeting point for intellectuals and artists from around the globe. Its
alleyways have been traversed by figures from the realms of arts and

music, such as Truman Capote, Delacroix, Matisse, the Rolling Stones,
Picasso, Tennessee Williams, or even Paul Bowles.

Tetouan :
The White Dove of
the Mediterranean
As a Mediterranean destination, distinguished as it is by its connection
to Hispano-Moorish culture, Tetouan is a prominent hub of cultural
tourism, owing to its Andalusian heritage. Its flagship attraction, the
Medina, designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, exudes prosperity
with its lively, picturesque alleyways surrounding squares and gardens.
This culturally rich city also enjoys seaside potential with natural beaches
stretching from Azla to Oued Laou.

Larache:
A Journey into Morocco's

Ancient History

Located a few kilometers from the ruins of the ancient Phoenician city of
Lixus and the Carthaginian and Roman port of the Middle Ages, on the

opposite bank of the Loukkos River, Larache offers considerable
potential as a holiday destination through the development of a diverse

range of offerings: Cultural, seaside, sports, and inland attractions.

Chefchaouen
The Blue Pearl of the Rif

Perched magnificently beneath the peaks of the Rif Mountains,
Chefchaouen boasts a unique charm. With its azure-hued house
facades, reminiscent of a fairy tale, Chefchaouen is a city steeped in
history, tradition, and authenticity. Additionally, it holds great potential
owing to its link to favorable natural and ecological conditions, with
waterfalls, natural parks, and mountain trails that offer delightful hiking
opportunities. Chefchaouen holds immense opportunities for the
development of rural tourism, in addition to featuring unique local
products.

M'Diq-Fnideq
Enchanted by the Seaside

Stretching over approximately 30 kilometers along the Mediterranean,
from Martil to Fnideg, and interspersed with three marinas - M'diqg,
Kabila, and Marina Smir - the luxurious resort of Tamuda Bay aims for
greater recognition. It epitomizes a seaside destination, and offers a
high-end product that combines relaxation, entertainment, and water
sports.

Al Hoceima
Manar Al Moutawassit

As a pivotal territory between the Oriental region and the Strait, Al
Hoceima is a breathtaking seaside destination with paradisiacal beaches

and rich natural sites offering relaxation and leisure.

In 2015, the city was ranked by the Global Urban City Guide as the seventh
most beautiful city in the world thanks to the beauty of its beaches. It was
also selected in 2014 as a member of the "very select club" of the most
beautiful bays in the world, an international association and trademark
created in Berlin.

However, Al Hoceima is not just a simple seaside town; its surroundings
conceal treasures that the most adventurous people find pleasure in

discovering unique relaxation spaces.

The vast natural spaces and sites that are fraught with culture and
history make of Ouezzane a magnet for ecological, cultural, and spiritual
tourism.
Its 17th-century medina, nestled on the flank of Mount Bou Hallal, gives
Ouezzane a charm and nobility. It is also known for its handicraft
products, as more than 8,000 artisans operate in various trades such as
weaving, sewing, leatherwork, and woodworking. However, wool
weaving remains the main artisanal activity, along with the Djellaba
Ouazzania, which is considered to be the province's trademark as a
whole.

Focus on AQUACULTURE

Inauguration of the new fish hatchery
in the Kingdom in the region of
Tangier-Tetouan-Al Hoceima

Marine aquaculture is an emerging sector in Morocco experiencing strong
growth through the implementation of several high-value aquaculture pro-
jects along the national coastline. The sector's momentum is closely tied to
the development of the entire ecosystem across the value chain, from seed-
lings to the infrastructure for distributing aquaculture products known for
their high quality. In this regard, the establishment of the new fish hatchery in
Tahaddart in the region of Tanger-Tetouan-Al Hoceima is considered a key

integration lever to ensure the viability of aquaculture projects specializing in
fish farming.

Inaugurated on July 18, 2023, in the muni-
cipality of Gzenaya, under the presidency
of Mr. Mohammed SADIKI, Minister of Agricul-
ture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and

Water and Forests, this hatchery, operated by the company Aquago, will
produce up to 30 million high-quality local fry of several fish species, inclu-
ding sea bream, sea bass, meager, and other species of interest to national
aquaculture farms. Spanning an area of 2.28 hectares, this structuring

project entails an investment of 120 million dirhams and is expected to
generate approximately 100 direct jobs.

Itis worth noting that this is the first fish seed production project in Morocco
for which the government provides financial support in the form of an invest-

ment grant for the acquisition of hatchery equipment.

Kingdom, targeting an investment exceeding 4 billion
MAD and a production of over 180,000 tons per year.
The fast growth of the fish farming sector entails
parallel development of fry production, one of the main

inputs of this sector. Indeed, the development of this AQUAGO

Indeed, incentive measures dedicated exclusively to the aquaculture sector
have been adopted to improve the business environment for this sector.
These measures include the exemption from VAT on key aquaculture inputs
(fingerlings and feed) and the reduction of customs duties on feed to 2.5%
(down from 25% previously). Furthermore, to control the upstream of the
value chain and diversify the supply sources of fish farms with fingerlings and
ensure the viability of projects specialized in fish farming, ANDA has included
the installation of a marine fish hatchery among its priority projects. Through
intense efforts and unwavering ambition, the project has undergone several
actions by ANDA, starting with the identification of a suitable site for the
hatchery with an area of 2.7 hectares, which subsequently underwent the
necessary administrative procedures with the local administration for its
leasing. This site meets several criteria, such as logistical facilities, the
availability of a source of high-quality seawater, the absence of pollution, and
sufficient area. To implement this hatchery, ANDA launched an Expression of
Interest to select the private partner who will carry out this strategic project in
partnership with the Agency. Aquago was selected in this context to make

this project a pioneer of its kind at the national level.

2. Contribution to Food Security

Q: How does this project contribute to food security and the socio-econo-
mic development of Morocco?

A: Food sovereignty has become an absolute priority worldwide, and
aquaculture is now among the key sectors for supplying populations with
animal protein and contributing to this global and national challenge. The
hatchery is the first link in the value chain, and the viability of fish farmers
depends on access to fingerlings at a competitive quality/price ratio to

produce under optimal economic conditions. This will be our commitment to

3. Aquaculture Challenges

Q: What are the main challenges facing Moroccan aquaculture, and how
does ANDA help overcome them?

A: All the structuring projects led by the ANDA have led to the emergence of
several aquaculture projects in the Kingdom. The challenge we all face is to
strengthen the growth of this sector to improve its competitiveness and
positioning in the aquaculture market with products that meet consumers'

expectations in terms of quality and diversity. To achieve this, the

on administrative, technical, and even financial aspects, to encourage their

income.

Ultimately, to complete this national determination for aquaculture

configurations of national coasts, in addition to encouraging innovation in
new technologies to offer investors suitable orientations aimed at efficiency

and optimization of farms.

4. Future Perspectives

Q: What are the future prospects for aquaculture in Morocco, and how does
the ANDA plan to contribute?

A: The High Royal Directives on matters of economic development have
emphasized the need to promote investment, encourage private initiative,
and support the new generation of entrepreneurs. His Majesty King
Mohammed VI, may God Assist him, emphasized in his speech on November
6, 2022, on the occasion of the 47th anniversary of the Green March, that "this
development dynamic explores new possibilities and horizons, especially in

sectors that are drivers of the blue economy."

In alignment with the Royal High Directives, the New Development Model
places aquaculture as a priority component of the blue economy. It enjoys
great development potential and is deserving of a strong impetus to achieve
the objectives assigned to it by aligning with a dynamic that aims to support
investors through appropriate technical and financial support in connection

with specific investment, transfer, and skills development activities.

We can only note the significant growth of the sector, which promises to

articulating it with the challenges of tomorrow; namely, maritime planning,

training, blue growth, social inclusion, marine environment preservation, and

mastering new technologies.
